scope.population: 2,480,267 row-aligned fills; every quoter is scored on the 1,234,777 LATE-half fills, and the identity quoters read a toxicity label frozen on the early half. The 50-early-fill floor selects 2,069 takers, of which 207 carry the toxic cut, and that set is what the bbgl per-tier term and the toxic-decile policy bounds read. The as_toxicity additive term does NOT read it: it is applied to every taker with a finite early estimate, one early fill being enough. The label-shuffle placebo follows the term rather than the floor -- both of its arms are built over that same finite-estimate population, counted in placebo_label_shuffle.arm_populations. See adverse_selection_term_value.eligibility_scope
scope.window: single December window; early days [4, 5, 6, 7, 8], late days [9, 10, 11, 12, 13]
scope.note: computed entirely on-disk from the two intermediates; no S3 re-pull. env_slice says whether CAP_DAYS or CAP_COINS narrowed the population for a smoke run

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

override_reasons.n_boot: the run drew 2000 resamples, which IS the declared 2000: stated as a CONFIRMATION and not as a deviation. Until 2026-07-31 the value came from the environment (CAP_N_BOOT) with a default of 300, so it was a property of the machine; the environment read is gone. Resamples are still capped at 200000 rows per draw (an m-out-of-n bootstrap), which is the size of one draw and not a second limit on their number, so the reported bands stay conservative.
override_reasons.master_seed: CONFIRMATION since 2026-08-03, not a deviation any more. Every stream this file DRAWS from is now opened by settings.rng on a named cell, so all of them derive from the declared 20260620 through settings.cell_key. The 20260623 recorded beside this is the per-purpose seed settings.SEED_BY_PURPOSE gives this consumer; after the repair it reaches nothing that is drawn -- it seeds numpy's legacy global state, which run_self_tests measures nothing here to consume, and it is the value _meta.seed reports. Until this run a single generator seeded 20260623 was threaded through the whole file, which made every band a function of how many quoters had drawn before it; see random_streams for the cells that replaced it and the proof that no two collide.
override_reasons.rank_floor_fills: the headline cell gates takers at 50 early fills, which IS the declared 50: a CONFIRMATION and not a deviation. It was 10 until 2026-07-31, when the reliability evidence behind the declaration was accepted. [10, 50] is still reported as the sweep, matching maker_econ.py so the bake-off and the B1 bound stay comparable

_meta.object: market-making bake-off (naive / symmetric A-S / A-S+toxicity / Glosten-Milgrom VPIN / GLFT / BBGL global+per-tier, plus three equal-width arms whose differences carry a declared axis and a measured held-equal list) on a common fill set + common net-P&L metric, walk-forward over the days present
_meta.author: Dmitry Stakhin

taker_map_meta.direction: wallet (hex string) -> integer code (int32, first-seen order)

_meta.fee_source: Hyperliquid fee schedule fetched 2026-06-21 from the official docs (hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/fees): maker 1.5 bps base -> 1.2/0.8/0.4 -> 0 bps (>$500M 14d vol); maker rebate -0.1/-0.2/-0.3 bps by 14d maker-volume share; taker 4.5 -> 2.4 bps. 1 bp = 0.01%.
_meta.split_rule: The EARLY/LATE halves are DERIVED from the days present, by settings.split_early_late through maker_econ.early_late_days: first ceil(n/2) days early, the rest late. They used to be hardcoded day-of-month tuples imported from maker_econ.py, correct only for a window opening on the 4th and closing on the 13th. This input does open on the 4th, so the derived split reproduces those tuples exactly and no number moved.
_meta.lambda_tox_note: headline FIXED at lambda_tox=1.0 (Glosten-Milgrom break-even); the range is reported as a sensitivity band only -- main() does NOT loop it, and the term is LINEAR in lambda_tox (lambda=0 == as_symmetric, lambda=1 == headline), so the endpoints bracket the band exactly without a separate run.

measures.net_PRINT: -a_print (mirror of taker print gain; nets entry spread; optimistic)
measures.net_MID_lower: s_q - a_mid; s_q = s_bbo + min(extra, max(a_mid,0)); the booked defensive widening can only OFFSET the adverse-selection cost on a printed fill, never over-collect (cost-not-alpha cap; no fill model invoked).

_meta.honesty: COST not ALPHA: every quoter is net-negative at every tier on the conservative net_MID_lower headline (check bakeoff_ranking.*.all_net_negative and cross_checks.cost_not_alpha for any optimistic-measure / rebate-tier exception rather than asserting universal negativity blind -- a fragile rebate-tier net_PRINT flip is known to exist on some coin/K); the AS term reduces cost never flips to profit; CONCENTRATED -- top 5 wallets hold 41.3% of the gain pooled on the one-sided as_toxicity minus as_symmetric pair, read back from pairwise_wallet_resolved.by_pair.*.concentration_by_wallet rather than typed, and read the two pairs apart: on the two-sided gm_vpin pair 21.6% of fills are NEGATIVE and the top fifty sum to 101.0%, so a share there is a gross contribution and not a concentration -- mostly ETH, fragile; counterfactual overlay NOT a matching engine; the A-S+toxicity term is a reduced-form instance of Barzykin-Bergault-Gueant-Lemmel 2508.20225, validation not invention. OOS SCOPE: the per-COUNTERPARTY toxicity labels (as_toxicity early_tox, bbgl per-tier) are frozen on the EARLY window before the LATE evaluation (strictly OOS); the market-level Glosten-Milgrom pi/J are FULL-WINDOW aggregates used as a deliberately-strong book-only benchmark (no counterparty identity), which only strengthens the negative control. Glosten-Milgrom cannot reach what the counterparty-resolved term reaches; GLFT vs symmetric A-S is a near-tie reported as a finding.
_meta.no_repull: computed entirely on-disk from the two npz; no S3 re-pull.

gm_pi_estimate.method: market-level VPIN/PIN proxy: per (coin,day) mean over 50 equal-COUNT buckets of |sum(sign)|/n; headline = per-coin median of the daily series. COUNT clock (notional is heavy-tailed; volume clock would degenerate on whale fills). FULL-WINDOW aggregate (early+late days), NOT early-only -- a deliberately-strong book-only benchmark for the negative control (makes the GM cost-reduction larger and the counterparty-resolution gap harder to clear, the conservative direction). NO counterparty identity; taker_id never referenced.

gm_J_estimate.method: J = mean(|markout at the headline horizon|) per coin (GM jump MAGNITUDE; mean-absolute, market-level, not counterparty-conditioned; FULL-WINDOW early+late, NOT early-only -- a deliberately-strong book-only benchmark, conservative for the headline); J_price = J_bps/1e4 * median entry_px.

rank_floor_independence.claim: no number in this block moves with the wallet selection floor
rank_floor_independence.basis: each entry is a function of four per-coin inputs -- the volatility from estimate_sigma over coin/day/entry_px, an arrival decay read off the realized half-spreads, the arrival anchor A_hat which is the coin's fill count, and the median entry price. build_context does read the toxicity labels, for the early/late masks and the per-taker terms, and none of those four inputs is built from them
rank_floor_independence.measured_by: rebuilding the block from the context of every rung in k_list and comparing the rungs leaf by leaf
rank_floor_independence.leaf_predicate: two leaves agree when both are the same number, or both are not-a-number, or both are the same non-numeric value; they differ when the numbers differ, when one is a number and the other is not, and when either side has no such key (a renamed key counts as two differences, one vanished and one appeared)
rank_floor_independence.what_the_old_key_cost: keying the block by the floor rung made every floor change look like sixteen values disappearing and sixteen appearing in an artifact diff, when the same sixteen numbers had merely been relabelled

naive_at_book.spec: naive fixed: s_q = s_bbo (quote AT the BBO; reproduces maker_econ net_MID_lower / net_PRINT). No inventory, no toxicity.

inventory_control_sim.note: no reservation skew (fixed-spread / market-level GM) -> uncontrolled null

naive_const.spec: naive fixed: s_q = H_const (one constant half-spread to everyone, the pooled LATE-half median s_bbo). Zero-information benchmark.

inventory_control_sim.note: no reservation skew (fixed-spread / market-level GM) -> uncontrolled null

as_symmetric.spec: Avellaneda-Stoikov (2008): inventory-only, counterparty-blind. Its content is the reservation-price inventory SKEW (reported via the control sim, control_ratio<0.5); it adds NO adverse-selection premium, so its income baseline = the book half-spread = naive_at_book. The A-S absolute spread LEVEL is a single-maker FLOOR (parameter-dependent), reported as_base_half_bps, NOT booked as income.

gm_vpin.spec: Glosten-Milgrom (1985): + market-level pi*J adverse-selection premium on top of the book; pi a VPIN/PIN proxy (Easley-Lopez de Prado-O'Hara 2012), J = mean(|markout at the headline horizon|). Book-only info, NO counterparty identity.

inventory_control_sim.note: no reservation skew (fixed-spread / market-level GM) -> uncontrolled null

bbgl.spec: Barzykin-Bergault-Gueant-Lemmel (2508.20225): + beta_g*global AS + beta_t*per-tier AS premia on top of the book (reduced-form instance; widen-only). Validation of the published quoting lineage.

as_toxicity.spec: + lambda_tox*max(early_tox,0) counterparty-RESOLVED AS premium on top of the book (reduced-form instance of the BBGL per-tier skew on OBSERVED identity; widen-only). Validation, not invention.

as_toxicity_ew.spec: EQUAL-WIDTH arm of as_toxicity: the same resolved term at the SOLVED pass-through that puts its mean extra on bbgl's, over the rank-floor-eligible counterparties (the population the per-tier term of bbgl is built on). Exists so that the difference against bbgl has ONE axis -- whether a fixed width is better allocated per wallet or per coin-and-decile -- rather than the three the six-quoter ranking carries. Not a second headline: the published as_toxicity arm is untouched.

bbgl_flat.spec: WIDTH-MATCHED negative control on bbgl: one flat constant equal to bbgl's own pooled mean extra, handed to every fill, conditioned on nothing. Same construction as flat_surcharge_control.py's one-global-constant variant, aimed at the quoter that finishes ahead instead of at symmetric A-S. Answers whether that quoter's result is its conditioning or its width.

inventory_control_sim.note: no reservation skew (fixed-spread / market-level GM) -> uncontrolled null

as_toxicity_plus_global.spec: bbgl's market-wide GLOBAL term kept exactly as that quoter computes it, with its per-tier term REPLACED by the counterparty-resolved term, the sum rescaled to the same mean extra by the same solved equation. Asks whether the resolved term improves the published Barzykin-Bergault-Gueant-Lemmel instance, not only symmetric A-S.

eligibility_scope.as_toxicity_term_population: every counterparty with a finite early toxicity estimate (at least one early fill with a finite markout at the headline horizon)
eligibility_scope.leaf_predicate: two leaves agree when both are the same number, or both are not-a-number, or both are the same non-numeric value; they differ when the numbers differ, when one is a number and the other is not, and when either side has no such key (a renamed key counts as two differences, one vanished and one appeared)
eligibility_scope.note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING THE K ROWS. The as_toxicity quoter's additive premium is lambda_tox * max(early_tox, 0) applied to EVERY counterparty that has a finite early toxicity estimate -- that is, at least one early fill with a finite markout at the headline horizon. The declared rank floor K (k_headline, k_list) is NOT applied to it: the term is built from the early_tox array, not from the eligible_mask_taker the floor produces, so a wallet with one early fill is quoted a widening on a one-fill estimate. The consequence is that the K rows of this block are not a sensitivity, and n_leaves_that_moved_with_k beside this note is the measurement of it, taken on the rows printed here: while it reads zero, a row-to-row comparison across K measures nothing at all. The floor DOES bite on the bbgl per-tier term, built from decile_of_taker and so sees eligible takers only, and on the toxic-decile membership the B1/B2 policy bounds read. It no longer bites on the label-shuffle placebo: from 2026-08-01 that placebo permutes over the SAME population this term is built on, because a null that hands premium to fewer wallets than the observed arm is not a null of this term at all. Recorded rather than repaired: gating this term on the floor would move a published quantity and is owed its own recompute.

declared_axis_comparisons.why: a ranking orders arms on one metric; it does not make any two of them comparable. Every difference below declares the ONE axis its arms are allowed to differ on, lists what is held equal, measures each of those on the published leaves, and is withheld if any of them missed

equal_width_solve.population: the resolved term of both solved arms is built over the rank-floor-eligible counterparties, the same population decile_of_taker gives the target's per-tier term; the published as_toxicity arm is built over every counterparty with a finite early estimate and is not touched by this solve
equal_width_solve.method: the resolved term is exactly linear in the pass-through, so the pass-through that lands the equal-weighted mean extra on the target's is solved and not searched; comparison_manifest measures the landing on the evaluated blocks and refuses the difference above 1e-09 relative

as_toxicity_ew_minus_bbgl.axis: HOW a fixed budget of defensive width is allocated: per counterparty wallet, from that wallet's own early adverse-selection estimate (arm a), against per coin plus per toxicity decile (arm b)

axis_preconditions.why: as_toxicity_ew carries the counterparty-resolved term at this pass-through; at zero or not-a-number the term is zero on every wallet and the declared axis is not present in this run

as_toxicity_ew_minus_bbgl.consequence_of_the_axis: the share of fills widened and the floor of the widening. An allocation that spends the whole budget on wallets with a positive score necessarily widens on fewer fills and reaches zero on the rest, while one that carries a market-wide leg widens on every fill and never goes below that leg. These follow from the axis and are reported, not held equal -- holding them equal would delete the axis.

held_equal_measured.measured_by: equal_width_solve.n_wallets_floor_eligible, which is len(labels.eligible_mask_taker) -- the set decile_of_taker is filled for and the set the solved arms' term is built over
RECOVER_FRAC, applied by the same line of evaluate_quoter to both arms; the offset cap min(extra, max(a_mid,0)) is that same line
HEADLINE_HORIZON, the rung every published difference is read at

not_held_equal.classified: CONFOUND on the per-coin rows and held equal on the pooled row only. The pass-through is one scalar per wallet and a wallet trades both coins, so a per-coin solve would quote one counterparty two unrelated prices. The pooled difference is the equal-width finding; the per-coin rows are reported for shape and are NOT it.

bbgl_flat_minus_bbgl.axis: whether the premium is CONDITIONED on anything at all: a single flat constant to every fill (arm a) against the global-plus-per-tier structure (arm b)
bbgl_flat_minus_bbgl.consequence_of_the_axis: the dispersion of the premium across fills, which is zero for the flat arm by construction. wallet_population is NOT on the held-equal list because the flat arm has none: it reads no counterparty.

held_equal_measured.measured_by: RECOVER_FRAC, applied by the same line of evaluate_quoter to both arms; the offset cap min(extra, max(a_mid,0)) is that same line
HEADLINE_HORIZON, the rung every published difference is read at

not_held_equal.classified: CONFOUND on the per-coin rows and held equal on the pooled row only. The pooled difference is the equal-width finding; the per-coin rows are reported for shape and are NOT it.

as_toxicity_plus_global_minus_bbgl.axis: which SECOND term rides on the shared market-wide global term: the counterparty-resolved one (arm a) against the per-tier one (arm b)

axis_preconditions.why: as_toxicity_plus_global carries the counterparty-resolved term at this pass-through; at zero or not-a-number the term is zero on every wallet and the declared axis is not present in this run

as_toxicity_plus_global_minus_bbgl.consequence_of_the_axis: the share of fills the second term reaches. Both arms widen every fill, because both carry the global leg; they differ in whether the remainder is spread over deciles or over wallets.

held_equal_measured.measured_by: equal_width_solve.target_global_leg_mean_extra_bps -- the same per-fill array enters both arms, arm b inside bbgl_half_spread_bps and arm a as ctx['bbgl_global_per_fill']

walk_forward.scheme: expanding train window over the days present, test on the next day; the same cuts t1_toxicity_skew_backtest._t2_walk_forward makes
walk_forward.split_produced_by: settings.split_early_late through maker_econ.build_toxicity_labels, over a two-day view of each fold (train rows day 0, test row day 1)
walk_forward.cell: pooled, base fee tier, net_MID_lower notional-weighted, h10; no bootstrap band and no inventory simulation on a fold
walk_forward.gm_inputs: pi and J are computed on the fold's TRAIN rows with their real days, so gm_vpin is strictly in-sample-up-to-t here; the headline uses a full-window pi/J on purpose and the two are not the same benchmark

random_streams.derived_from: settings.rng, which seeds from settings.MASTER_SEED and the cell identity flattened by settings.cell_key; the identity is built from names and integers and never from hash(), which Python salts per process
random_streams.why: a stream identified by its cell rather than by its position in a run is independent of the roster of quoters and of the order any loop walks them, so that a stranger executing this code gets the results the paper presents

fill_aware_b2.label: recapture APPROXIMATION (NOT a matching engine / queue / fill-probability)
fill_aware_b2.positive_cells_are_a_known_fragility: any positive net_vw_bps in this grid is the documented whale-driven, mostly-ETH, single-fragile-rebate-tier flip on the optimistic recapture surface; it is NOT a deployable edge / alpha -- the headline is a COST reduction that never robustly flips to profit. Unlike evaluate_quoter this grid is uncapped, so it is excluded from the all_net_negative guard by design and self-flagged here.
fill_aware_b2.note: f=0 reproduces B1 decline-entirely; f=1 is widen-only; m unchanged by widening (information does not vanish). f/w/c swept, not estimated.

arm_populations.predicate: np.isfinite(early_tox), the same predicate build_context books on
arm_populations.which_arms_that_sentence_is_about: the two arms of the TEST, count_matched. The rank_floor_gated block beside it is gated at the floor on purpose and is not one of them
arm_populations.what_changed: the null arm used to write NaN outside the rank-floor-eligible set while the observed arm kept every wallet with a finite estimate, so a sub-floor wallet carried a positive premium in the observed arm and exactly zero in every draw; the observed reduction was measured over more wallets than any draw of its own null, which raised the observed value and lowered the p. The floor moving from 10 to 50 on 2026-07-31 widened that gap without touching the observed arm.

size_matched_null_lives_in.matched_on: total late notional of the observed toxic set
size_matched_null_lives_in.why_not_here: toxic wallets are also large, so a size-matched null is what separates identity from size; it is drawn once, against the policy bound, and this file scores quoters rather than redrawing it

placebo_label_shuffle.note: gm_vpin is the built-in negative control: its half-spread is a pure function of a market-level VPIN/PIN proxy with taker_id NOT referenced, so a label shuffle leaves it unchanged. This file draws the COUNT-matched null, which is the test, and beside it the RANK-FLOOR-GATED null, which is not: the second is published so the cost of an unmatched arm can be quoted from arm_difference rather than described. The size-matched null is maker_econ's, named in size_matched_null_lives_in.
placebo_label_shuffle.which_arm_the_prose_leads_with: count_matched.reduction_vs_null_net_vw_bps with its ci95_wallet_clustered. rank_floor_gated is the UPPER bound and is quoted as one; arm_difference is the measured distance between them and is what the unmatched arm was worth.

pairwise_wallet_resolved.measure: per-fill booked extra half-spread (bps) at 10s, RECOVER_FRAC * min(extra, max(a_mid,0)); difference a minus b, notional-weighted over late fills
pairwise_wallet_resolved.cluster_level: taker wallet (taker_id), because the treatment varies by wallet
pairwise_wallet_resolved.zero_is_by_construction: as_toxicity minus as_symmetric cannot be negative: as_symmetric books no adverse-selection premium and as_toxicity books a non-negative one, so a zero negative share there is the booking formula speaking, not a measurement. Only the gm_vpin pair is two-sided.

naive_at_book_reproduces_maker_econ_h60_.print_row_scope: finite a_mid_60 AND finite a_print_60 (both sides)
naive_at_book_reproduces_maker_econ_h60_.print_scope_note: the print legs are compared on the SAME rows. The bake-off books s_q = s_bbo + RECOVER_FRAC*min(extra, max(a_mid_60,0)), so a non-finite a_mid_60 drops the fill from net_PRINT even for naive_at_book (extra=0), while maker_econ's print measure carries no a_mid term and keeps it. n_late_rows_print_finite_mid_nonfinite is exactly the set that differs. Scoring maker_econ on all print-finite rows instead gives maker_econ_net_PRINT_vw_bps_all_print_rows; the two differ only by those rows, and no fill is valued differently by the two sides.

cross_checks.gm_uses_no_identity_basis: not computed at runtime: it is a code-level property. The gm_vpin branch of quoter_extra_half_spread_bps reads ctx['gm_half_lut'] indexed by arrs['coin'] only, and estimate_pi / estimate_adverse_move take no taker_id argument, so no counterparty identity reaches the GM half-spread. The lookup array is built in build_context from gm_half_bps, which is pi*J per coin.

oos_disjoint.note: toxic label uses ONLY early fills; every quoter is scored on late fills only.
